notes.title: Patch Notes for Beta Fixes - 0.3.1
notes.notes:
🌟✨ New Features ✨🌟
- Cooperative Mode and Combat!
- Polyoedia: Collect everything and learn some trivia. (Still incomplete)
- Balanced stages
- Store update values have been adjusted
- Serpentosaurus: The Boss of the Plant stage!
- Bosses in general have been updated
- Windmill now has lower upgrade values
- All towers now take exactly 3 seconds to build
- Damage per second is now dealt 10 times per second instead of depending on FPS
- New way to calculate Score
- Game menus are now easier to understand

- Rhom enemies are no longer immune to all towers, just very resistant

🐞 Bug Fixes 🐞
- All towers in general have been fixed; attack speed was inconsistent
- ELON enemies are now resistant to the type that received the most damage, except when it's their weakness
- Some redundant enemies have been removed
- The control settings screen only works once

- GameSpeed is now ranged between 1 and 6
- Wind Tower (Windmill) now give reduced gold while close to other Windmill
- Electrict Tower (Thunderbolt) balance
- More Enemies Types

🐞 Bug Fixes 🐞
- Water Tower (Icewave) Power Left (Crystalyze) are not weakening the enemies properly
- Plant Bosses are too strong (Level 24)
- Boss destruction animation is interrupted by end game screen
- Gamepad fixes
- Fire Tower (Pyrocaster) Arc damage is not giving damage according to enemy size

notes.title: Welcome to the beta
notes.notes:
🎮 Game Update: Version 0.1.3 Patch Notes

Greetings, Beta Players!

We're excited to announce the latest update to our beloved game, and we want to extend our heartfelt thanks for your continued support during our beta phase. Your feedback has been invaluable in making our game even better. In this update, we've squashed some pesky bugs and added a special surprise for our dedicated beta players. Here's what's new:

Bug Fixes:
💰 Gold earned per match adjusted
♟ Stage 4 and Stage 5 adjusted 

New Achievement for Beta Players:
🏆 Beta Player🏆

As a token of our gratitude for your support and dedication during our beta testing phase, we've introduced a brand-new achievement exclusively for our beta players. This achievement, "Beta Player," will be awarded to all players who participated in our beta testing program. It's a symbol of your invaluable contribution to the game's development.

To claim your "Beta Player" achievement, simply enter the game.

Thank you once again for being a part of our gaming community. We can't wait to continue this adventure with you as we work toward future updates and improvements.

Happy gaming, and may your quests be epic!
